summary.text: Lee Ann Kluger is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 6, where she assumed office on December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired educator and children's author, she serves on the Education Policy and Administration Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lee Ann Kluger graduated from Crestwood High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Bloomsburg University in 1980, and earned a graduate degree from Lesley University in 1998.
Her career experience includes working as an author and educator, and she is retired.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Kluger said she has lived in New Hampshire for over thirty years and taught grades from kindergarten through sixth grade as well as gifted and talented and Title 1 programs.
She said she is fluent in English and Spanish and, as a children's author, supports the arts in education.
Her stated priorities included legislation addressing child food insecurity, public education, and accountability for Education Freedom Accounts.
